definitions.explanation: A tall body or physique. Used to describe someone who is notably tall. Functions as a noun that modifies other nouns with の.

examples.japanese: {長身|ちょうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っていた→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: A tall man was standing there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{長身|ちょうしん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧。
examples.english: She stands out because of her tall stature.

examples.japanese: ⟦バスケットボール→バスケットボール：04724_basukettobooru⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦らしい→らしい：09502_rashii⟧{長身|ちょうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧きた。
examples.english: A tall young person who looked like a basketball player came into the café.

notes:
A descriptive noun used as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧. More literary and precise than simply saying ⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ (tall). Often appears in written descriptions of people's appearance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {長身|ちょうしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧/⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧ (a tall man/woman)
- {長身|ちょうしん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{細身|ほそみ}→細身：20336_hosomi⟧ (tall and slender)
- {長身|ちょうしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かす (to make use of one's height)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{背|せ}→背：02907_se⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ — tall (everyday adjective)
- {長身|ちょうしん} — tall stature (descriptive noun, more literary)
